sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
instruct: Gender: male. Age: seventies. Role: wandering bard and bowyer. Pitch: warm, slightly raspy baritone. Pace: slow, rhythmic, with lilting emphasis on lyrics. Emotion: gentle, nostalgic, wistful. Characteristics: soft, resonant, with a touch of gravel from years of travel. Use case: fantasy RPG dialogue, tavern storytelling, poetic narration.
